summary: A parent of a child enrolled in Montgomery County Public Schools (MCPS) believes that the FCC should continue the E-Rate program and strengthen the conditions on receiving E-Rate funding. The parent cites concerns about digital distraction and inappropriate content on the internet, which can degrade children's ability to learn. The parent requests that the FCC require or incentivize E-Rate schools to adopt curricula that prioritize teacher-led instruction, report instructional screen time, adopt

claims.requested_action: Tie E-Rate decisions to educational outcomes
claims.argument: The FCC should strengthen its enforcement of the Children’s Internet Protection Act (CIPA) to combat digital distraction and prevent access to inappropriate content
claims.evidence_quote: The FCC should strengthen its enforcement of the Children’s Internet Protection Act (CIPA) to combat digital distraction and prevent access to inappropriate content
